archetypes.name: dyn-stale-coverage-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Recovery must stay limited to the exact stale-live mismatch and preserve proceed-partial.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect finalize teardown disposition recovery and final_report plan-coverage omission. Confirm only ShipError('coverage artifact does not match live repository inputs') is recoverable, missing recovery coverage re-raises, proceed-partial still skips done rename, and other ShipError values still fail closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
